quickSummary: Real gases deviate from ideality due to intermolecular attractions (constant a) and finite molecular size (constant b). Includes critical constants (T_c, P_c, V_c, Z_c = 0.375), 10 high-yield NEST traps, and a 36-term master glossary.

conceptBreakdown.heading: 8.1 Real Gas Regimes & van der Waals State Equation
conceptBreakdown.title: 8.1 Real Gas Regimes & van der Waals State Equation

summaryBox.title: van der Waals Equation
summaryBox.takeaway: (P + an²/V²)(V - nb) = nRT. Moderate P: Z = 1 - a/(V_m RT) < 1. High P: Z = 1 + Pb/(RT) > 1. H₂/He: Z > 1 always.

conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
COMPRESSIBILITY FACTOR (Z)
   Z = P V_m / (RT)
   ├── Z = 1  ⟹ Ideal Gas
   ├── Z < 1  ⟹ Negative Deviation (Attractive forces 'a' dominate)
   └── Z > 1  ⟹ Positive Deviation (Co-volume 'b' dominates, e.g. H₂, He)
conceptBreakdown.content:
• **Critical Constants**:
$$\mathbf{T_c = \frac{8a}{27Rb} \quad \vert \quad P_c = \frac{a}{27b^2} \quad \vert \quad V_c = 3b \quad \vert \quad Z_c = \frac{P_c V_c}{R T_c} = \frac{3}{8} = 0.375}$$
• **Boyle Temperature ($T_b$)**: Temperature at which real gas behaves ideally over wide pressure range: $\mathbf{T_b = \frac{a}{Rb} = 3.375 T_c}$.
• **Inversion Temperature ($T_i$)**: $\mathbf{T_i = \frac{2a}{Rb} = 2 T_b}$.

conceptBreakdown.heading: 8.2 10 High-Yield NEST Thermodynamics Traps
conceptBreakdown.title: 8.2 10 High-Yield NEST Thermodynamics Traps
conceptBreakdown.content:
1. **Free Expansion Entropy**: $\Delta S_{\text{sys}} = n R \ln(V_2/V_1) > 0$ because free expansion is irreversible.
2. **Universe Entropy**: Spontaneity requires $\Delta S_{\text{total}} = \Delta S_{\text{sys}} + \Delta S_{\text{surr}} > 0$. $\Delta S_{\text{sys}}$ can be negative.
3. **Liquefaction Factor**: Liquefaction depends on **constant $a$** (attraction), NOT $b$.
4. **Heat Capacity Units**: $C_{p,m} - C_{v,m} = R$ applies to molar heat capacities; $C_p - C_v = nR$ for $n$ moles.
5. **Adiabatic Cooling**: Reversible adiabatic expansion causes cooling ($T_2 < T_1$).
6. **Ozone Enthalpy**: $\Delta_f H^\circ[\text{O}_3(g)] = +142.7\text{ kJ/mol}$ (NOT zero).
7. **High Pressure Deviation**: Real gases exhibit $Z = 1 + \frac{Pb}{RT} > 1$ at high pressure.
8. **Endothermic Spontaneity**: Spontaneous at high $T$ when $\Delta S > 0$ and $T > \Delta H / \Delta S$.
9. **Speed Order**: $v_{\text{rms}} > v_{\text{avg}} > v_{\text{mp}}$ ($1.225 > 1.128 > 1.000$).
10. **Third Law Scope**: Applies strictly to perfectly crystalline solids; disordered crystals ($\text{CO, Ice}$) retain residual entropy.

quickRevision: Higher 'a' means higher T_c and easier gas liquefaction.
